name: Google Stitch MCP
description: Google Stitch as native mcp__stitch__* tools in DeepSeek Harness, with an in-panel credential card for the API Key and OAuth access token.
longDescription:
Connects DeepSeek Harness to the official Stitch MCP endpoint (`https://stitch.googleapis.com/mcp`, Streamable HTTP) and registers its toolkit as `mcp__stitch__*`:

- `list_projects` / `get_project` / `create_project` / `delete_project`
- `list_screens` / `get_screen` / `download_file`
- `generate_screen_from_text` / `edit_screens` / `generate_variants`
- `list_design_systems` / `create_design_system` / `create_design_system_from_design_md` / `update_design_system` / `apply_design_system`
- `upload_design_md`

The plugin page adds a credential card with two tabs. **API Key** stores the documented `X-Goog-Api-Key`; **OAuth** stores an access token sent as `Authorization: Bearer`, optionally pinned with `X-Goog-User-Project`. Values go through the host `credentials` service (write-only, never read back) and are re-read per request, so a change applies without a restart.

No proxy setup is required: the plugin routes each request itself — direct first, then a proxy it finds on the machine (environment, the Windows system proxy, or the usual local proxy ports) — and uses a configured proxy first when the card sets one. A machine without a proxy needs no configuration.

Diagnostics live in `~/.dsh/dsh-runtimes/stitch-mcp/status.json` and `relay.log`.
author: yangjiacheng
